subject: redis-cli fixes around help hints version filtering (#13097)
reason: This is a valkey-cli bug fix in the legacy help-hint version-filtering path (versionIsSupported and removeUnsupportedArgs in src/redis-cli.c), reached only when the CLI compares the connected server's reported version against the command/argument `since` strings compiled into cli_commands.c (all between 1.0.0 and 8.x). Both builds under test report REDIS_VERSION 255.255.255 (src/version.h), newer than every `since`, so versionIsSupported returns 1 at the first numeric comparison (255 > since's first component, unchanged code) for every command and argument: the new equality/digit-count branche
